entry.title: Read the card-morph map without joining and sorting
entry.content:
Read the card-morph map without joining and sorting

get_card_morph_map_cache joined Card_Morph_Map with Morphs and ordered the
result by (lemma, inflection). The join made sqlite materialize a lemma and
an inflection for every row of the map table -- 235279 of them on the
big_japanese_collection test fixture -- and then sort all of them, while the
loop above it kept one Morpheme object per distinct morph (14302 of them) and
dropped the rest.

Morphs is now read once into those objects, and the map table is read on its
own. Its primary key already is (card_id, morph_lemma, morph_inflection), so
the per-card ordering comes from walking that index rather than from a sort.
Each card still gets its morphs sorted by (lemma, inflection), which is what
the previous global ORDER BY produced and what the extra fields depend on. The
order between cards changes, but it was never observable: the return value is
a dict keyed by card id.

The function goes from 1293ms to 537ms (-58%) on that collection, roughly
three quarters of a second off every recalc.

entry.title: fix: don't crash on startup on anki 26.08+
entry.content:
fix: don't crash on startup on anki 26.08+

Anki 26.08 removed aqt.package.venv_binary along with the uv launcher,
so importing it at module scope stops the entire add-on from loading:

    ImportError: cannot import name 'venv_binary' from 'aqt.package'

Resolve the interpreter used to bootstrap the spaCy/CAMeL venvs in a new
get_python_binary() helper instead: use the launcher venv when it exists,
fall back to the running interpreter when that is a real python, and
return None on the self-contained builds that ship no interpreter.
